name: Torres de Albarracín (Spain)
description: Square white standard within concentric borders of green, white and red and a chequered outer edge, charged at the centre with a six-pointed star of red, green and white lozenges.
history: Municipal flag of Torres de Albarracín; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: concentric borders of green, white and red with a chequered outer edge
red border and lozenges of the star
six-pointed star of red, green and white lozenges at the centre
